combo1.title: Yummy Starter Combo
combo1.description: The fundamental Yummy combo that establishes your basic board. This combo demonstrates the core synergy between Cupsy, Snatchy, and the field spell Mignon.

steps.text: Snatchy Synchro Effect: Send Snatchy and Cupsy

combo2.title: Obedience Schooled Combo
combo2.description: Leverage Obedience Schooled to summon three Level 2 Beast monsters from your deck. This explosive combo creates multiple Synchro and Link plays, establishing a powerful endboard with Snatchy, Marcher, and Herald.

combo3.title: Hornet Drones Combo
combo3.description: A Sky Striker engine combo using Hornet Drones to generate tokens and Link materials. This versatile line demonstrates how Yummy can incorporate external engines for extended plays.

combo4.description: Special Summon Marshmao from hand to kickstart your combo. This efficient two-card starter establishes your field spell and searches key combo pieces through CupsyWay.

combo5.title: Going second Snatch Combo
combo5.description: A going-second strategy that uses Yum?Yum?Yummys to remove an opponent monster and immediately Synchro Summon LollipoWay. Perfect for breaking established boards.

steps.text: Activate Effect: Send Snatchy & Opponent Monster

combo6.title: Advanced Lollipo Starter
combo6.description: An advanced combo line starting with Lollipo that builds a full endboard including Herald, Marcher, and multiple Snatchys. This is your most powerful combo when you have the right pieces.
